theme_strategy: Light Theme Default (Off-White Background) with High-Contrast Pop Art/Neo-Brutalist Elements

display_font.usage: Graphic objects, oversized single words, main headings, numbers
display_font.style: Uppercase only, tight tracking (tracking-tighter), solid filled and outlined variants (using text-stroke).

body_font.usage: Body text, UI elements, small concise copy, buttons
body_font.style: Highly readable, normal to medium weight, standard tracking.

neo_brutalism.borders: Thick solid black borders (border-2 or border-4 border-[#111111]) on cards, inputs, and buttons.
neo_brutalism.interactions: Physical press interactions. On hover/active, the element translates down and right to overlap its shadow, while the shadow reduces. e.g., active:translate-x-[8px] active:translate-y-[8px] active:shadow-none.

visual_enhancers.graphic_language: Custom ASCII/SVG graphic elements acting as editorial ornaments: oversized punctuation marks, arrows, stars (4-point or multi-point), circles, registration marks, crop marks, editorial lines, and brackets.

grids_and_layouts.strategy: Swiss-inspired editorial grid system. Aggressive asymmetry.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous padding, tight internal lockups. Use massive negative space to build tension between giant typography and very small precise UI text.

navigation.elements: Logo (HERMES SOFTWARE INC.®), Links: ABOUT, WORK/SERVICES, PRICING, FAQ. Controls: EN/TR Language Toggle, [START A PROJECT] bold button.
navigation.behavior: Solid background with thick bottom border to separate from scrolling content. START A PROJECT opens a Contact Form Modal.

hero.content: 'WE TURN IDEAS INTO SOFTWARE.' or 'WE MAKE THINGS MOVE.'
hero.visuals: Oversized typography acting as graphic art. Asymmetric layout.
hero.motion: Hard-easing on-load reveal. Masked line-by-line text reveal using framer-motion.

marquee.content: SOFTWARE / PRODUCT / DESIGN / ENGINEERING / BRAND / AUTOMATION / DIGITAL PRODUCTS
marquee.styling: Thick top and bottom borders, vibrant background (e.g., Yellow or Red), large bold uppercase text. Linear continuous scroll.

who_we_are.content: Giant bold statement occupying 70% of the grid vs. concise, tiny, strictly formatted paragraph copy occupying 30%.

services_grid.styling: Varied card sizes (col-span-1, col-span-2), different vibrant background colors per card. NOT six identical cards. Some with outlined text, some with solid text.

testimonials.motion: Columns scroll slowly in opposite directions (up, down, up).
testimonials.content: Clearly marked placeholder text (e.g., 'LOREM IPSUM CLIENT QUOTE'). Include avatar placeholders (use provided creative portraits).

pricing_estimator.title: WHAT ARE WE BUILDING?
pricing_estimator.features: Project type selection, complexity toggle, add-ons. Currency switch (USD/EUR/TRY).
pricing_estimator.styling: Physical neo-brutalist controls (heavy toggles, big clickable blocks, NOT boring form radios).
pricing_estimator.output: Massive animated rolling number for estimated project value.

faq.styling: Oversized leading numbers (01, 02...). Thick borders between rows. Sharp open/close animations.

final_cta.content: HAVE AN IDEA? LET'S BUILD IT.
final_cta.styling: Strongest accent color background (e.g., Blue or Red). Largest typography on the site. Massive interactive button.

footer.content: HERMES SOFTWARE INC.® / ISTANBUL, TURKEY / EMAIL INSTAGRAM GITHUB LINKEDIN / © 2026 / BUILT WITH INTENT.
footer.styling: Grid alignment, uppercase, mono-spaced or clean sans.

contact_modal.styling: Neo-brutalist window. Thick borders, flat colors. Saved to backend conceptually (use standard form logic).

motion_and_interactions.scroll: Lenis smooth scrolling is REQUIRED for the editorial, momentum-heavy feel.
motion_and_interactions.animations: Framer Motion for scroll-triggered typography displacement, clip-path reveals, and hard easing (e.g., cubic-bezier(0.87, 0, 0.13, 1)).
motion_and_interactions.banned_motion: NO generic fadeInUp everywhere. Use purposeful kinetic motion.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over vibrant colors meets APCA/WCAG standards. Use Black (#111111) text on Yellow, Red, Blue, and Green.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='pricing-currency-toggle').

instructions_to_main_agent.core_directive: This is NOT a generic SaaS site. Execute with brutalism, pop-art contrast, and extreme structural tension. Do not center everything. Break the grid intentionally.
ui_rules: No generic gradients. Use flat vibrant colors (#FFE45C, #FF5C5C, #45B7D1) heavily.
NEVER use generic corporate copy ('leveraging cutting-edge technology', 'end-to-end solutions', 'empowering businesses').
Buttons MUST translate into their shadow on active state to simulate physical buttons.
Use massive typography. The hero should feel like a printed poster.
Build Shadcn components natively using raw HTML/Tailwind where Shadcn is too rigid, but use Shadcn for complex interactives (Forms, Modals, Accordions).
Make sure you include Lenis for smooth scrolling in your layout.
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic: don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and thick black shadow offsets.
DO NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, physical press effects.
